observed: A complete record is vector-copied to prev before stlr xzr of cur footer. stlr xzr is followed by dmb ish and only then by stage/cell stores. cut 4 calls _exit(84) after that dmb and before those stores. cut 5 calls _exit(85) after the cell store and before commit_seq/footer release. cut 3 calls _exit(86) after commit_seq and before stlr of the new footer. cut 6 calls _exit(87) after stlr of the new footer and dmb ish. Cuts 1 and 2 store the committed cut and return the sequence only after that same stlr/dmb. mark_array_body at 0x5ca8 and 0x5cf8 calls _gc_diag_publish, then faults with ldr xzr only when the returned sequence is nonzero and the stack cut is 1 or 2. The original cell load is ldr x25,[x27] after that check. The original header load is ldr x20,[x20] after the cut-2 check.
notOriginalLoad: The faulting ldr xzr reads a stack slot previously stored as zero. It is the null probe, not the original cell or header operand.
